product_name.value: 磁吸直升机造型充电风扇台灯

use_environment.value: 宿舍床架下书桌及低天花板阁楼

design_direction.value: 严格参照上传图片的天蓝色圆鼓机身、细长尾梁、尾翼与装饰尾桨、白色滑橇和顶部吊杆吸顶座；主旋翼纯白无彩色桨尖；双侧圆窗改为不透明浅蓝色

light_exit.value: 机身前方与底部，半透明3D打印材质

power_architecture.value: 同一充电能源供给，灯与风扇独立驱动、独立开关，可同时工作

controls.value: 左右浅蓝圆窗中心各一个圆形按钮，外表曲率与窗面连续；灯泡及四叶风扇图标

charging_connector.value: USB Type-C，尾梁下方，具体位置由设计方确定

envelope_interpretation.value: nose to tail fin length, not main rotor swept envelope

value.retention: 薄胶固定；按胶厚调整磁铁露出量

rotor_mechanism.value: 固定吊杆承重，环形旋翼毂通过轴承绕吊杆转动，偏置电机传动；向下送风，尾桨固定装饰

button_assignment.value: 左控灯、右控风扇；短按开关，上电关闭

lighting_target.value: 在保持已确认外观的前提下，独立照亮读书写字区域；重新匹配光源、恒流驱动和散热，灯板20mm及平均0.5W不再是固定限制

charging_behavior.value: 检测到USB VBUS时由固件关闭灯和风扇；拔线低电平稳定500ms后仍保持关闭，须重新按键；不提供硬件断电隔离

materials.value: 天蓝色及浅蓝PETG壳、半透明乳白PETG灯罩、白色主旋翼；旋翼材料及转速需原型验证

cabin_plan_shape.value: circle; both side windows centred on transverse axis through cabin sphere centre

belly_light_shape.value: small horizontal flat opening, not a large curved translucent belly

front_aperture_adjustment.value: slightly smaller than the previous front opening

window_button_proportion.value: Small central button within a fixed opaque pale-blue window and rounded porthole frame; follow reference window proportions

detail_refinement.value: Refine landing skids and tail fin to match the supplied image

rotor_visual_refinement.value: Widen the main rotor blades only; do not increase their existing thickness

landing_gear_form.value: Struts curve smoothly outward and downward from below the side windows to the skids, without exposed straight horizontal and vertical segments; fore/aft mirrored about the cabin sphere centre

window_frame_construction.value: Separate silver-grey or white overlay ring covering the perimeter of each opaque pale-blue window

body_colour.value: sky blue, including cabin shell, tail boom and tail fin

tail_reference_detail.value: Vertical fin is exactly symmetric above and below the tail boom centreline; white three-blade decorative tail propeller on aircraft left; horizontal trim fin on aircraft right at tail tip, identical in shape and size to one half of the symmetric vertical fin

window_colour.value: opaque pale blue, lighter than the sky-blue cabin; window frames keep their white colour

window_colour_srgb.value: #C9EAF8 on window panes and central buttons

tail_propeller_alignment.value: Move the tail propeller aft slightly to visually centre its axis within the fore/aft fin outline

landing_gear_height_refinement.value: Shorten landing struts by another 3mm from the previous 24mm vertical drop, retaining smooth curvature and symmetry

appearance_approval.value: Proceed with current appearance after shortening struts another 3mm; begin internal component design

clean_exterior.value: 内部布局不得破坏参考图外轮廓；取消额外外露开孔和凸出安装结构

window_retention.value: 窗体自带承靠机身的厚度台阶，另有独立覆盖窗框；固定结构藏于机身内

tail_retention.value: 实心尾梁的圆形截面一部分承靠机身，一部分短插入；插入长度略大于壳厚，机身后方仅露圆形尾梁

skid_root_retention.value: 起落架根部增加可靠的内部固定结构

charging_access_direction.value: rearward +X on lower rear spherical wall; horizontal XIAO cassette below battery

value.motor: Pololu3060 5:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor HPCB6V,no encoder
value.control: independent fan PWM; hardware current limit and latched stall shutdown; reset on off

value.validation: prototype lux grid through actual front/bottom printed diffusers; targets are engineering defaults,not a GB/T9473 certification claim

value.USB_interlock: 灯扇关闭、拔线后须重新按键

assembly_priority.value: 以最简单组装方式制作，优先减少用户亲自焊接、接线及安装内部零件的步骤，保持已确认外观与灯扇功能

assembly_delivery_default.value: 厂家完成下壳功能总成与上盖旋翼总成的预装、烧录、校准和试装；用户只套皮带并以三颗M2x10合盖，厂家可整机交付时优先整机交付；不宣称内部物理减件已经完成
